profile.headline: Engineer @ AWS
profile.summary:
After convincing my parents to buy me a QBasic programming book in third grade, I was off to the races.  Initially, I was self-taught, until I was lucky enough to attend one of the best high schools in Georgia, The Walker School.  Upon my enrollment, they also began offering a Computer Science course.  Dr Vesey was influential to me beyond what she even knows to this day, and she helped me begin learning OOP languages. 

While at UGA, I wasn't sure if I wanted to do a CS degree or Math, so I started in CS but shifted gears to a hybridized Mathematics degree program where I was able to combine my interest in systems design with mathematical and even biological topics.  I took a Mathematical Biology course which was arguably the most interesting class.  

For me, my heart has always been in technology.  It's no surprise that I find myself devoting all my free time to anything related to computers, gaming, vehicles, programming, and things like that.   

I currently work as a full stack engineer for Twitch on the IVS team.  See https://aws.amazon.com/ivs/ for more details on what we do.

positions.title: User Interface Engineer
positions.description:
- Full Stack Engineer with a focus in UI Performance on the Marketplace Delivery Stream
- Built custom functional UI components for Autotrader.com using React.js, ES6, Redux, and SASS
- Helped establish guidelines for best practices in Javascript / React to maximize component performance and minimize unnecessary re-renders using memoization, dependency analysis, Lighthouse reporting, and bundle profiling.
- Managed REST microservices in Node.js
- Wrote automated tests in Jest, Cypress, and Selenium to be run on Saucelabs
- Deployed code via Jenkins/Git to AWS Beanstalk environments using Docker
- Collaborated, adapted, and improved utilizing Agile Scrum and Lean methodologies

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description: React, React Router, Redux Sagas, SASS, Semantic UI, Node, Express, Webpack, and AWS.

volunteerExperiences.role: Mentor for M.S. in Cybersecurity students
volunteerExperiences.description: I work with students working towards their Masters degrees to help them grasp the material and succeed.
A group of us represented our company as we helped build a house for someone in need.  I now know how to install a roof and siding!!
